subject: [PATCH v5 02/15] NFSD: validate transport name in listener_set before serv creation

2026-09-01.patch_summary: This patch adds a validation check for the transport name in the listener_set netlink command before creating a service. The code checks if the provided transport name is one of 'tcp', 'udp', or 'rdma' and rejects any other names. This prevents an arbitrary string from reaching the svc_xprt_create_from_sa function, which can trigger a request_module upcall under nfsd_mutex. The check is done in the nfsd_nl_validate_listeners function before taking the nfsd_mutex lock.
